changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.users ( id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, login VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, birth_date DATE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id) );
